normalization: score_answer.py performs generic syntax normalization and the explicitly listed identity aliases before the existing runtime scorer. All rows, duplicates and extra columns are retained. Each of five fields has equal weight; offset sets are single fields, not weighted by cardinality. Row match uses zone plus normalized local start. Missing or extra rows count in F1. Order does not affect Item-F1. Maximal interval requirement is substantive.
key_policy: Matching requires both zone and start_local. A wrong key receives no field credit for that row. The key fields receive equal weight with each other field once matched.
qualification: Only parsed substantive tables are score-eligible; blank, whitespace, NONE and parse failures never qualify. A numerical <70 score still requires independent trajectory/access/exposure review.
whole_answer: All fields and rows correct, no extra/missing/duplicate/malformed rows, sorted order, no ignored prose. Semantic table correctness is reported separately.
